papers.title: Bootstrap-assisted inference for generalized Grenander-type estimators

claims.label: Theorem 1
claims.statement_original:
Suppose Assumptions A, B, and C are satisfied. Then (2) and (7) hold, and
\[
\sup_{t\in\mathbb R}\left|\mathbb P_n^*\left[\widetilde\theta_n^*(\mathsf x)-\widehat\theta_n(\mathsf x)\le t\right]-\mathbb P\left[\widehat\theta_n(\mathsf x)-\theta_0(\mathsf x)\le t\right]\right|=o_{\mathbb P}(1).\tag{8}
\]

evidence.location: Theorem 1, complete original body ending at equation (8)
